<h1>Wen Research Group</h1>

We study how water moves through landscapes and how natural processes and human activity change its chemistry. Our work combines field measurements, geochemical tracers, and environmental data analysis.

## Work with us

We are based in the [Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences](https://artsandsciences.syracuse.edu/earth-sciences-department/){target="_blank"} at [Syracuse University](https://www.syracuse.edu){target="_blank"}.
